_note: Honest per-sequence baseline for FusionCore NCLT regression tracking. This is NOT the published marketing table: it is the reference the regression checker (tools/check_benchmark_regression.py) diffs new runs against, so a change that helps one sequence but hurts another is caught the same day instead of drifting silently for weeks. Numbers are FusionCore ATE RMSE in metres, SE3-aligned to RTK ground truth. Regenerate a sequence entry from its results/metrics.json (produced by tools/evaluate.py --json).
_status: MEASURED 2026-08-14 on current main with ukf.alpha=1.0. Sequence 2013-04-05 at 1x playback: FusionCore 131.85 m ATE RMSE 3D, robot_localization 229.66 m. This is a 97.5% improvement over the same run at the previous alpha=0.1 default (5268.80 m), and RL was within 1.2 m across all three runs as the control. It is still 5.7x worse than c8b8b1f (19 May) which measured 22.96 m on this machine, so a SECOND regression remains unidentified between May and now: alpha was the dominant cause, not the only one. Only 2013-04-05 has been re-measured; every other entry below predates the alpha fix and is NOT a valid reference. SUPERSEDED as of 2026-08-05. Every number below was measured with gnss.max_speed active and no sigma term in its bound, a configuration since shown to reject good GPS and cascade into drift: on 1200 s of 2013-04-05, the old bound gave 125 IMPLAUSIBLE_JUMP rejections and 915.0 m ATE where the fixed bound gives 3 rejections and 5.5 m. These entries are therefore not a valid reference for current main and must NOT be used to judge a regression. A controlled full-suite re-run on current main is owed before any entry here or any published number is updated. Previous status: PARTIAL, only 3 of 12 sequences staged. PARTIAL.
